name: Houzuki Homura
source: A sophomore student at Ayakashi University. He's a sporty type and is captain of the basketball team. Homura may look rough around the edges and act on the aggressive side, but people seem to like him once they get to know him. He's active throughout a lot of the day, staying out late most nights.
translation: A sophomore student at Ayakashi University. He's a sporty type and is captain of the basketball team. Homura may look rough around the edges and act on the aggressive side, but people seem to like him once they get to know him. He's active throughout a lot of the day, staying out late most nights.
